activity.notes: Jang Bogo established Cheonghaejin with royal approval in 828 and held the distinctive title Cheonghaejin Commissioner while dominating regional maritime security and trade until his assassination in 846.

sources.title: 장보고
sources.citation_text: The Encyclopedia of Korean Culture states that Jang Bogo established Cheonghaejin in 828, held the title Cheonghaejin Commissioner, and died in 846.

sources.title: 대사
sources.citation_text: The Encyclopedia of Korean Culture identifies the Cheonghaejin Daesa title and states that Jang Bogo was appointed to it in 828.
